content:
Arcadia's hotel reservation service in Poland selects the right hotel for your family in Warsaw, Krakow, Zakopane, Gdansk and Wroclaw, confirms it at a fixed price, and provides the booking confirmation required for a Schengen visa file. We book hotels we know and visit ourselves, not from generic lists, and we look for what matters to Arab families: family and connecting rooms, breakfast with clearly halal options, proximity to the old town or the station, and quiet nights.

What the service includes

  • Two or three hotel suggestions matched to your budget and trip style, with photos and locations.
  • A confirmed booking in your name within 24 hours, at a fixed price including taxes.
  • A cancellable confirmation for your Schengen visa application while the visa is pending.
  • Special requests: connecting rooms, cots, quiet floors, rooms away from the bar, late check-in.
  • Changes or cancellation according to the hotel's policy, handled for you.

Where to stay in each city

  • Warsaw: the centre near the central station and metro for convenience, or the Old Town for atmosphere.
  • Krakow: the Old Town if you want everything on foot, or Kazimierz for halal restaurants nearby.
  • Zakopane: hotels on Krupowki street, or mountain cottages for large families.
  • Gdansk: the Old Town on the waterfront, or the seaside resorts of Sopot.

Named hotels with prices are in the best hotels and cottages in Poland.

Prices peak in June–August and December (Christmas markets) and are lowest in March, April and November.

What to check before confirming

  • Arrival and departure dates and the number of nights.
  • Room type and the real number of beds (European rooms are small; a family of four needs a family room or two rooms).
  • Cancellation and change policy, and check-in time.
  • Breakfast: included or not, and its halal options.
  • Parking if you have a car, and distance from the station.

Frequently asked questions

Can I book only the hotel without a program?
Yes; hotels alone are available, and cheaper as part of a program with a car and guide.

Is the confirmation enough for a Schengen visa?
Yes, together with the other documents (flight tickets, insurance, bank statement).

When should I book?
At least two months ahead for summer and the Christmas markets, one month for the rest of the year.

How do I pay?
At a fixed price including taxes, by transfer or card link.

Request your hotel booking in Poland

Send the city, dates, number of travellers and children's ages on WhatsApp +7 706 400 7561 or through offers and reservations. See also tourism in Poland and Poland for families.
